Counting: a comparison is one < / <= / > between two keys; a move is one write of a key into a list slot (a swap = 2). The sort key is each transaction's position in the triage order (band desc, Amount desc, Time asc, txn_id asc), which orders exactly like the packed integer key in my Python code. Runs over 20 s are stopped and shown as DNF. Browser JavaScript is much faster than CPython, so absolute times differ from the report, and comparisons and moves follow the same counting rules. Samples and shuffles use a seeded JavaScript generator (seed s), so counts for n < 284,807 or C2/C5 differ slightly from the report's Python runs; full-file C1, C3 and C4 inputs are identical.
